title: Petri Dishes

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: Shallow, lidded dishes used to hold solid (agar) growth media for culturing microorganisms.
safety: Label the base, not the lid, since lids can be swapped between dishes.
Store agar-side up during pouring and incubate inverted (lid-down) to reduce condensation dripping onto the agar surface.
